title: macOS host runs satellites only; corpus daemon lives in the cage
content: The corpus daemon runs in the cage (blackbox.daystrom.app); no local blackboxd service exists on this macOS host post-cutover. The com.daystrom.blackbox launchd label is retired and leftover plists on disk are unloaded; nothing serves 127.0.0.1:7264. The host runs only satellites under launchd: collectors (bbox-code-collector, bbox-slack-collector), fleetd, and lane-pool helpers. The stablesign/kickstart redeploy runbook applies only to these locally-deployed sidecar binaries, never to a corpus daemon; corpus changes reach production via the cage image path (submit-bbox-verify.sh gate, submit-bbox-build.sh image, then `scripts/converge.sh --image <tag>` from bbox-cage). Config-dir nuance still applies: Rust dirs::config_dir() resolves to ~/Library/Application Support, so bro fleet may read ~/Library/Application Support/blackbox/fleet.json, while ~/.config/blackbox/ keeps the main config.toml and a mirrored fleet.json; check/update both fleet.json files when changing fleet-local settings unless BLACKBOX_CONFIG is explicitly set.
